nom: fresh Sugar Strawberry Exfoliating Face Wash

avis.texte: I used to love this product but now I just like it. I love the smell and I love the feel of the exfoliation. However, I think the product consistency for a wash has changed…. I'd suggest you used a good facial wash/cleanser before or after it…..

avis.titre: Wishing your outlets were still open.
avis.texte: I have been using your products for over TWENTY YEARS. That should say it all! I am soooo sorry that you closed your wonderful outlets because everyone at your store was so knowledgeable and helpful.
First time buying it and I am really happy how it melts into your skin
An employee recommended this product. I had my doubts initially…. But I absolutely love this product. The strawberry scent is subtle. I love the tecture of this facial scrub. Would recommend.

Made me skin itch and burn, not sure why. None of the ingredients are a known allergen. Doesn't exfoliate at all, which sucks because I've been trying to find a new exfoliating face wash because my old brand changed their formula and it smells awful now. Also, disappointed that you can't give something a go and then return it. That'll definitely keep me from buying any new products from Fresh.

avis.titre: my favorite part of my skincare routine
avis.texte: i've loved this exfoliator for a while; as well as other Fresh products. i was constantly buying the mini versions of these while traveling and while they did last, i had to commit to the full one for my house and i am not disappointed! its super gentle with micro sugar crystals and smells sooo yummy and luxurious. my skin craves a good exfoliant and i really like how this one leaves skin clean and flawless without dryness! its great all over the body in the shower too.

i'll start off saying it smells so good, i'll use it when i need a mood booster. i use it after a basic cleanser, so my skin does feel clean after using. but it barely exfoliates, which is a huge let down. the sugar ingredient feels like it dissolves almost as soon as it touches my skin, and it doesn't leave my skin feeling smooth

I love this stuff! I read some of the other reviews, and I definietly disagree. I have sensitive dry skin, but this stuff works beautifully! It is all natural and has improved my skin tone and texture over time. I use this once a day, and its made a huge differnce. It does have a scent, but its natural, and not artificial. I dont mind the smell. It's personal preference I guess. If youre looking for a natural exfolient that wont destroy your skins barrier, this is it!

I didn't find this to have enough scrub. You could feel some grain in the product when you squeezed it out, but once I started to apply to my face, what little sugar scrub just dissolved. This product would be better for someone who wants a very light scrub (and isn't allergic to strawberries) Unfortunately for me, I want to feel the grains and get a high grit to scrub my face. If you're like me, then this product is not for you. Therefore this product does what it advertised: a gentle scrub.

I've been a Fresh fan for YEARS, and tried this product after it appeared that the Soy Exfoliant had been discontinued. I've gotta say, I don't really think it hits the mark - as an exfoliant, the sugar crystals dissolve before I can really finish getting my entire face (and I didn't start with a lot of water), and as a cleanser, it didn't really remove my makeup and left a weird film behind. I ended up following it up with Soy Cleanser to finish, so I can't say how my skin felt afterward. On the plus side, it smells amazing. I wish I would have liked it more.
